item.title: Angels corrupted us? This Bible book says yes
item.description:
Investigate the profound mystery of the Bible's forbidden book.

One apostle quoted it as scripture. But if you search your Bible, this book is silent. What chilling secrets did it hold?

An ancient text, quoted by an apostle, vanished from your Bible. The Book of Enoch describes fallen angels, giants, and humanity's corruption – revelations that terrified religious leaders for centuries. Why was this sacred book banished? What forbidden truths about our origins and fate did the Church attempt to erase from history? Join us to uncover this unsettling mystery.
